Name: qxtClientServiceCosts
Sql:
TRANSFORM Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) AS TotalCost
SELECT c.LastName & ", " & c.FirstName AS ClientName
FROM tblServices AS s INNER JOIN ((tblClients AS c INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn ON c.ClientID = csn.ClientID) INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON csn.ClientServiceNeedID = csp.ClientServiceNeedID) ON s.ServiceID = csn.ServiceID
WHERE (((csp.FiscalYear)=GetCurrentFiscalYear()))
GROUP BY c.LastName & ", " & c.FirstName
PIVOT s.ServiceName;
